note: AC-5 dogfood demonstration (specification.md §7): a REAL git worktree checkout of this repository at HEAD genuinely exposes its own ablation gold artifacts (scripts/benchmark/ablation-tasks.ts, mutating-tasks.ts) to an agent's read_file tool — this is the real vulnerability every M1 ablation producer had before this fix, not a contrived example. checkGoldLeakage (src/metrics/leakage.ts) correctly flags it as leakageAssertion: failed on the unmodified worktree, and correctly reports leakageAssertion: passed once the gold artifacts are stripped (the fix now wired into run-ablation.ts, run-ablation-codex.ts, run-ablation-mutating.ts). No live case is run against the leaked worktree — per AC-5 it is excluded from scoring, not scored and zeroed. validatePairedBenchmarkV2's own hard invariant (a manifest containing any leakageAssertion: failed run is invalid) is separately unit-tested in src/metrics/benchmark.test.ts.
